rows.market_wrap: Nifty rebounded 1.14% to 25,514 and the Sensex added about 990 points in a broad-based rally led by autos (Maruti up 7.6%) and banks, with Nifty Bank closing above 63,000 for the first time; IT was the one weak spot, falling for a third session as TCS and Infosys slipped. Your stocks and ETFs fell 0.4% despite the rally because silver and gold dropped again. Today's mutual-fund NAVs were still not on AMFI at 10:07 PM IST, so fund values (and most of the day's ₹6,807 fall) reflect 18 November, when silver and mid caps slid.
